description:
Find used and new cars for sale at South African dealerships, and the new car specials they are running, without leaving ChatGPT. Dryv's stock is strongest in the Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal, and it grows every week.

Ask the way you would ask a friend: "good used cars under R250,000 in the Western Cape", "used SUVs under R350,000 in Cape Town", "used bakkies for sale", "a Toyota Hilux with low mileage", "Chery specials". Dryv shows matching cars as cards with the photo, price, mileage, town, the dealership and its Google rating, and a link to the full listing on dryv.co.za, where you can contact the dealer.

New car specials are read from each dealership's own website every day, so a special that has ended disappears. Each one shows the monthly instalment or cash price, the end date, and the dealer's stated terms.

Where Dryv has enough identical cars in the same province to compare, a car priced below them carries a Great Price badge.

Dryv only shows cars and specials that are listed on dryv.co.za today, at the prices the dealerships set.

Used bakkies for sale in the Western Cape
